scripts.db:docker: docker compose -f compose.yml --env-file .env up -d db redis && echo DATABASE_URL=postgresql+psycopg://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/mission_control && echo REDIS_URL=redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0
scripts.db:docker:down: docker compose -f compose.yml --env-file .env stop db redis
scripts.db:docker:logs: docker compose -f compose.yml --env-file .env logs -f --tail=200 db redis
